title: The Copper Creek
text: A creek running green over copper stones, the water bright and bitter, the banks stained the colour of verdigris. Nothing drinks here. Nothing grows. Easy pickings, if you do not mind your hands turning green for a week.

options.label: Pan the bitter creek, and never mind the green hands.

outcomes.text: A good haul, and green hands for a week, and a bitter taste that will not leave.

options.label: The strongest dams it to dig the bed, and takes everything it holds.

outcomes.text: A great haul, and the village below runs dry, and curses your name for a generation.

options.label: Trace the creek to its source, where the copper runs thickest.

outcomes.text: A rich vein, and something guarding it that has grown green and bitter too.
